chapter_title: Banks and the Magic of Finance

items.title: What is Financial Infrastructure?
items.explanation: Financial infrastructure comprises a network of banks, payment systems, stock markets, and other financial institutions. It enables people, businesses, and the government to facilitate financial transactions and manage money efficiently.

items.title: How do Banks Function?
items.explanation: Banks act as intermediaries that collect money from depositors in the form of deposits and lend it to borrowers or businesses. They offer services like saving, withdrawing, and borrowing money, which impacts daily life by enabling monetary transactions.
